title: Dean's conjecture and cycles modulo k
summary: Dean conjectured three decades ago that every graph with minimum degree at least $k\ge 3$ contains a cycle whose length is divisible by $k$. While the conjecture has been verified for $k\in \{3,4\}$, it remains open for $k\ge 5$. A weaker version, also proposed by Dean, asserting that every $k$-connected graph contains a cycle of length divisible by $k$, was resolved by Gao, Huo, Liu, and Ma using the notion of admissible cycles.
